entries.name: conventional-commit
entries.author: teddytennant
entries.description: Write a conventional commit subject and body from the current diff. One change per commit. Do not invent a scope.

entries.name: plain-writing
entries.author: teddytennant
entries.description: Write prose that reads like a person wrote it. Use for comments, READMEs, commits, PRs, and docs.

entries.name: pr-description
entries.author: teddytennant
entries.description: Write a pull-request title and body from the current branch against its base. Why, what, how to test. No marketing.

entries.name: undercover
entries.author: teddytennant
entries.description: Keep public git history clean: no AI attribution footers, no blocklist leaks in commits or PRs.
